en.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！

en.text: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. from my sin.

zhSimplified.text: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽，

zhTraditional.text: 求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡，

en.text: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

zhSimplified.text: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你；

zhTraditional.text: 我向你犯罪，惟獨得罪了你；

en.text: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

zhSimplified.text: 你所喜爱的是内里诚实；

zhTraditional.text: 你所喜愛的是內裏誠實；

en.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. and I will be whiter than snow.

zhSimplified.text: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净；

zhTraditional.text: 求你用牛膝草潔淨我，我就乾淨；

en.text: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我得聽歡喜快樂，

en.text: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
Create in me a clean heart, O God. a right spirit within me.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你为我造清洁的心， 的灵。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你為我造清潔的心， 的靈。

en.text: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

zhSimplified.text: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面；

zhTraditional.text: 不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面；

en.text: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. me with a willing spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂，

en.text: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. will be converted to you.

zhSimplified.text: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人，

zhTraditional.text: 我就把你的道指教有過犯的人，

en.text: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你是拯救我的 神；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你是拯救我的上帝；

en.text: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇张开，

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇張開，

en.text: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 你本不喜爱祭物，若喜爱，我就献上；

zhTraditional.text: 你本不喜愛祭物，若喜愛，我就獻上；

en.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. the walls of Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 求你随你的美意善待， 的城墙。

zhTraditional.text: 求你隨你的美意善待， 的城牆。

en.text: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭

zhTraditional.text: 那時，你必喜愛公義的祭
